readmeMarkdown:
# Mnemosyne OS for Antigravity

Turn [Mnemosyne OS](https://mnemosyne-os.io) into a visual cockpit for
Antigravity and launch your own apps on a tier-1, local memory operating system
for Windows, macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux.

This plugin bundles always-on safety rules and four workflows for Antigravity.
They connect your agent to isolated vaults, live desktop canvases, offline
voice engines, Telegram render reviews and custom apps on your machine.

| Surface | Link |
|---|---|
| Product site | [mnemosyne-os.io](https://mnemosyne-os.io) |
| Documentation | [docs.mnemosyne-os.io](https://docs.mnemosyne-os.io) |
| Company and labs | [mnemosyne-os.com](https://mnemosyne-os.com) |
| App source repository | [Mnemosyne-OS/Mnemosyne-Neural-OS](https://github.com/Mnemosyne-OS/Mnemosyne-Neural-OS) |
| Custom app and cartridge SDKs | [npmjs.com/org/mnemosyne_os](https://www.npmjs.com/org/mnemosyne_os) |

## A visual cockpit for Antigravity

Once connected, Mnemosyne OS gives Antigravity users a spatial control room
alongside every coding session.

- **Live agent cards and radar:** Pin live session cards on the canvas with
  `mnemosyne_cockpit_update`. Detect file and branch edits across Antigravity
  and Claude Code transcripts, even app closed.
- **Board, windows and apps:** Open, focus, fullscreen and arrange desktops,
  links and widgets. Control interactive apps such as `God's Eye View`, `Atlas`,
  `Molecule`, `Vitrine Studio`, `MnemoClio` and `MnemoCRM` via `os_find` and
  `os_run`.
- **Shared tasks and watches:** Track tasks in your To-do list, edit Agenda
  appointments and read Pheme watch radars.
- **Voice, video and Telegram review:** Generate offline voice-overs and voice
  clones (`qwen3`, `chatterbox`, `zonos`, `piper`) locally. Render avatar films
  and note videos, then review frames in Mnemosyne OS or on Telegram.

## Launch your own apps on a tier-1 memory layer

Antigravity users can build and launch their own apps on governed local
vaults.

- **Guided creation:** Build websites in **Vitrine Studio** or 3D objects in
  **Lab 3D**. Frame custom app specs in **Muse** and hand them to Antigravity.
- **Sandboxed canvas cartridges:** Build React or Vite widgets inside the canvas
  with
  [`@mnemosyne_os/cartridge-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mnemosyne_os/cartridge-sdk)
  under user permissions.
- **Standalone Layer 2 apps:** Connect Node or browser apps on `127.0.0.1:7799`
  with [`@mnemosyne_os/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mnemosyne_os/sdk)
  or `npm create @mnemosyne_os/app`.

Watched folders feed isolated vaults on your machine. Search fuses vector
ranking with local BM25 (`mnemosyne_memory_query`) and RAG answers
(`mnemosyne_memory_ask`). Protection tiers (`MAXIMUM`, `isolated`), Dream State
links and Resonance keep memory separate and resumable.

## Requirements

You need **[Mnemosyne OS Infinity Edition](https://mnemosyne-os.io/download)**
installed on the same machine. The desktop app ships both MCP servers inside
its own bundle.

Once connected, `mnemosyne_agent_list`, `mnemosyne_agent_collisions` and
`mnemosyne_agent_files` read local coding-agent transcript metadata directly
from disk. Those three tools work even while the desktop app is closed. Vault
memory, review, voice, To-do, calendar and desktop actions require the desktop
app running locally.

## What this plugin bundles

| Type | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Always-on rules | `rules/AGENTS.md` | Vault discovery, protection tiers and multi-agent Git safety |
| Skill | `skills/mnemosyne-memory/SKILL.md` | Vault memory recall, ingest provenance and agent coordination |
| Skill | `skills/mnemosyne-review/SKILL.md` | Video and image review on desktop and Telegram |
| Skill | `skills/mnemosyne-voice/SKILL.md` | Local offline voice-over synthesis and voice cloning |
| Skill | `skills/mnemosyne-desktop/SKILL.md` | Window, board and interactive app control via `os_run` |

## Connect Mnemosyne OS and configure your vaults

This plugin supplies the rules and skills. The desktop application supplies and
connects the two local MCP servers: `mnemosyne` (memory, review, voice, To-do,
calendar and agent awareness) and `mnemosyne-actions` (`os_find`, `os_run`,
image and video tools).

1. Install and open **Mnemosyne OS**.
2. Open **Settings › Agents › Connect my coding agent**.
3. Click **Antigravity**.

That button writes both server entries into `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`.

Without `MNEMO_VAULTS`, a read that names no vault falls back to the first
mounted vault, and a write that names no vault is refused. To choose specific vaults, add `MNEMO_VAULTS` and
`MNEMO_DEFAULT_VAULT` inside the `env` block of the `mnemosyne` entry in
`~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`:

```json
{
  "env": {
    "MNEMO_DEFAULT_VAULT": "CODE",
    "MNEMO_VAULTS": "CODE,JOURNAL,RESEARCH"
  }
}
```

Use each vault folder name in uppercase. To enable local voice synthesis tools,
add `"MNEMO_VOICE": "1"` to that same `env` block and restart your session. The
app preserves your custom `env` keys when reconnecting.

## Privacy

The Mnemosyne OS memory server connects locally on `127.0.0.1:7799`. It
collects no telemetry, runs no analytics and stores no data of its own. What the
agent reads goes to the AI session you run, and to your Telegram chat when you
ask it to send a file. Embeddings follow your Mnemosyne OS setting: with a
local model, they are computed on your machine. Full policy:
[mnemosyne-os.io/confidentialite](https://mnemosyne-os.io/confidentialite).

desktop application (open core).

## Acknowledgments

Mnemosyne OS started on Gemini 1.5. Thanks to Google for Gemini and
Antigravity.

Bundles always-on safety rules (rules/AGENTS.md) and four workflows: mnemosyne-memory, mnemosyne-desktop, mnemosyne-review, and mnemosyne-voice. Connects to Mnemosyne OS Infinity Edition via Settings > Agents > Connect my coding agent > Antigravity.
